These elements interact non-linearly, forming a system that can be analyzed through spectral decomposition to extract dominant modes of success or failure. The tensor's eigenvalues represent key performance indicators such as strategic adaptability and resilience under pressure. The coaching index acts as a temporal modulation factor influencing the evolution of the skill vector, while the skill vector itself defines the operational range within which the team can perform. Failure modes emerge when eigenvalues collapse or when the skill vector becomes orthogonal to strategic axes, indicating misalignment between talent and execution.
